meta.name: ai-video-generation
meta.description: Generate AI videos with Google Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan, Grok and 40+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse 1.0, Wan 2.5, Grok Imagine Video, OmniHuman, Fabric, HunyuanVideo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, video upscaling, foley sound. Use for: social media videos, marketing content, explainer videos, product demos, AI avatars. Triggers: video generation, ai video, text to video, image to video, veo, animate image, video from image, ai animation, video generator, generate video, t2v, i2v, ai video maker, create video with ai, runway alternative, pika alternative, sora alternative, kling alternative, seedance, happyhorse

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一句描述或一张图片变成可发布的 AI 视频,无需拍摄和剪辑软件。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速产出视频内容却没有拍摄与剪辑团队。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a prompt or a photo into a publishable AI video without filming or editing software.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need video content fast but have no filming or editing team.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 inference.sh 的 belt 命令行调用 Veo、Seedance 2.0、HappyHorse、Wan 等 40+ 模型生成视频,涵盖文生视频、图生视频、对口型、视频编辑、放大和加音效。
howto.when: 当你提到「text to video」「veo」等关键词,或要求用 AI 生成、编辑视频时接管;需先装好 belt CLI 并 belt login。

say.text: 用 Veo 3.1 生成一段无人机飞过森林的视频
把这张图做成动画,用 Wan 2.5 图生视频
say.note: 调用 falai/wan-2-5 处理该图

say.text: 用 Seedance 2.0 生成带声音的爵士乐队视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can call 40+ video models (Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan and more) via the inference.sh belt CLI: text-to-video, image-to-video, lipsync, video editing, upscaling and foley sound.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention terms like "text to video" or "veo", or ask for an AI-generated video; the belt CLI must be installed and logged in.

say_en.text: Make a video of a drone flying over a forest with Veo 3.1
Generate a jazz band video with audio using Seedance 2.0
